purpose_context: ADR-0059 D1 makes an operation's design-derived @contract scenarios and contract tests the gate for core's switch. #9 holds the scenario coverage and #72 the blocking gate; PR #507 re-scoped both. The suite already fails when a 2xx answer is exercised by no scenario (OperationCoverage, R-20), but nothing names, per operation, which scenarios cover it, which refusals they pin, or whether it is switchable. Core's half of #72 (its proxy refusing a switch) is core work at incorporation.
purpose_tldr: Make 'this operation is switchable' an explicit, checked per-operation register: every operation core will switch to has behavioral @contract scenarios and contract tests, and the build fails when one lacks them.
